messages:
maria_support: Hey team — customer reported consistent 400s when using tool/function calling from TS SDK but same payload from Python works. Error: \"tool args failed schema validation\". Attaching minimal repro below.

eric_ts: Which SDK versions? any proxy in front?

maria_support: TS sdk @ 2.0.1, Python sdk @ 1.2.3, Go client @ 0.9.7. No proxy on their side, direct to api.redwood.com. Customer says requests from our TS SDK appear to double-escape JSON in tool args.

priya_py: Can you paste the raw request bodies they sent from each client?

maria_support: Pasted. Python (works):
```
POST /v1/chat HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model":"redwood-chat-1",
  "messages":[{"role":"user","content":"run tool"}],
  "tools":[{"name":"lookup","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"query":{"type":"string"}},"required":["query"]}}],
  "tool_call":{"name":"lookup","args":{"query":"{\"id\":123,\"filters\":[\"active\"]}"}}
}
```

maria_support: TS (failing):
```
POST /v1/chat HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model":"redwood-chat-1",
  "messages":[{"role":"user","content":"run tool"}],
  "tools":[{...}],
  "tool_call":{"name":"lookup","args":"{\\\"query\\\":\\\"{\\\\\\\"id\\\\\\\":123,\\\\\\\"filters\\\\\\\":[\\\\\\\"active\\\\\\\"]}\\\"}"}
}
```

priya_py: Aha. TS is sending args as a string containing escaped JSON, not an object. Schema expects object with field `query`. That would trigger validation.

ashwini_eng: Do we know which layer is serializing twice? Could be our TS SDK's tool-call helper wrapping args with JSON.stringify inadvertently. Also check our runtime: we accept both object or string? spec requires JSON object for args.

eric_ts: I pulled the TS helper — in 2.0.1 we added a last-minute convenience to accept nested objects and call `JSON.stringify` for tool args. But I see a bug: when the user already provides a string, we again call `JSON.stringify` and so send a quoted JSON blob. Repro: `const args = JSON.stringify(payload); send({ args: JSON.stringify(args) })` -> double encode.

maria_support: Customer says they passed a JS object (not a string) to the SDK call. Why would it become a string in the final payload?

eric_ts: If the SDK sees a typed `ToolArgs` union and user passes a typed object, we `JSON.stringify` once (correct). But later our transport layer has a small sanitizer that tries to `JSON.stringify` any non-string fields to ensure content-type. That sanitizer is serializing again because the field is already a string at that point. So bug is double-JSONify in the SDK call path.

priya_py: Can we confirm Go client behavior? customer tried Go and saw same as Python (works). So likely only TS has the sanitizer.

ashwini_eng: Quick mitigation: runtime can accept args that are strings by attempting to parse them if schema expects object/array. We can accept both. But better to fix SDK to not double-encode. Which teams should do patch? @eric_ts to patch TS lib, @chris_devex to publish advisory and workaround in docs.

chris_devex: I'll draft a support note and workaround patch: recommend users pass plain objects and upgrade to patched TS SDK (2.0.2). Workaround for now: if you see tool args as a string in payload, call `JSON.parse(args)` server-side or in proxy to convert. I'll push a snippet.

maria_support: Customer is blocked — they use ts-sdk 2.0.1 in prod. Any chance of a hotfix release today?

eric_ts: I'll cut 2.0.2 with test and publish within the hour. Patch will remove sanitizer double-JSON and add explicit `typeof` checks. I'll also add a test covering nested JSON in args and ensure transport doesn't touch pre-stringified values. :shipit:

ashwini_eng: For safety on runtime side, I'll add a tolerant parse fallback in inference runtime that, when encountering `tool_call.args` as a string but schema type is object/array, attempts `JSON.parse` once and proceeds if valid. This will avoid customer outages if they can't upgrade immediately. I'll target a canary within 3 hours.

maria_support: Repro steps (to include in ticket):
- Use TS SDK 2.0.1, call `client.callTool('lookup', { query: { id: 123, filters: ['active'] } })`
- Capture outgoing HTTP body (network tab or proxy) and confirm `tool_call.args` is a JSON string containing escaped JSON (double-encoded).
- Server logs show: `400 Bad Request - tool args failed schema validation: expected object for property query`

priya_py: Add to ticket: curl repro that imitates buggy payload so eng-runtime can test fallback:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"run tool"}],"tool_call":{"name":"lookup","args":"{\\\"query\\\":\\\"{\\\\\\\"id\\\\\\\":123}\\\"}"}}'
```
chris_devex: I'll also add a line to SDK release notes and update the support KB with: "If you see schema validation errors for tool args from TS SDK, upgrade to 2.0.2 or apply the temporary server-side parse fallback."

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: eng-runtime canary at 2026-03-17T16:20:00Z (patch includes tolerant parse), eng-runtime full rollout 2026-03-17T18:00:00Z.

maria_support: Thanks. Assigning customer ticket INC-2026-4391 -> set priority P1 and notifying account team. I'll follow up once TS patch is published and runtime canary verifies. :heart:

eric_ts: Published 2.0.2 tag and npm release, changelog: "fix: avoid double-JSON serialization for tool args (thanks @maria_support for repro)". PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/421

maria_support: Closing loop — customer confirmed workaround (server-side parse) unblocks them until they can upgrade. Will keep ticket open until runtime full rollout and customer upgrade.
